backgrounds: a dockworker down at the harbor
a night-shift nurse in a city hospital
a rideshare driver working late shifts
a line cook at a diner that never quite closed
an office worker three years into a job they never loved
a freelance mechanic who fixed cars out of a garage
a college student one semester from graduating
a volunteer firefighter in a town too small to pay one
a barista who'd been saving up to travel
traits: quick with a joke to defuse tension
can't resist helping a stranger, even at real cost to themselves
always the one making the plan, whether anyone asked or not
keeps every promise, even small ones, like it matters more than it should
curious to a fault, unable to leave a mystery alone
guarded with strangers, fiercely loyal once trust is earned
prone to speaking their mind before thinking it through
calm in a crisis, in a way that unsettles people who aren't
near_death_events: a car accident on a rain-slicked highway
a sudden cardiac arrest that stopped their heart for nearly four minutes
a house fire they didn't escape in time
a fall from scaffolding at a job site
a drowning nobody pulled them from until it was almost too late
a severe allergic reaction with no epinephrine in reach
a violent mugging that went further than either side intended
a climbing accident on a route they'd done a dozen times before
a bridge collapse during rush hour
a stroke that hit without a single warning sign
ideals: get home, whatever it costs and whoever it costs
this world didn't ask for me, so I owe it nothing but the truth
the people here are real; their problems are real; that's enough to act on
never leave someone worse off than I found them
a debt is a debt, in any world
understand a thing before you fear it
power should answer to the people it lands on
if the Veil chose me, it can explain itself
keep moving; a life that stops is a life that's over
the small kindness is the one that counts, because no one's watching
bonds: someone back home is still setting a place at the table, not knowing
there was a promise I made the week I died, and it's still not kept
a name I never said out loud is the reason I want to go back
the last stranger I helped in my old life is the one I keep thinking about
I carry one object from before, and I will not lose it
the Warden of the Veil knows something about me, and I mean to have it
whoever pulled me under, I owe them a reckoning
the first person to be kind to me in Aetherfall has my loyalty for good
the version of me that almost lived is the one I'm trying to become
somewhere there is a door back, and finding it is the only map I follow
flaws: I trust a good explanation over a bad feeling, even when the feeling is right
I can't walk past someone in trouble, which has nearly killed me twice now
once I've decided you're safe, I stop watching you
I'd rather be the one with the plan than the one who's right
I keep my worst news to myself until it's too late to help
I hold a grudge like it's the only thing I brought with me
I mistake being needed for being wanted
I'll gamble my own safety before I'll ask anyone for help
I talk when I should listen, especially when I'm scared
part of me doesn't actually want to go home, and I can't say why
